text:
maria: Quick sync — NVIDIA asked for an acceptance gate we can both sign off on before we publish the joint perf/W report. Thinking: throughput targets, sustained watt envelope, and kernel stability across quantized configs.

alex: +1. can we list concrete numbers? e.g., 99th perc latency < 30ms, sustained throughput >= 1k seq/s, and power < 320W under our standard load?

jin: I like concrete thresholds but we should separate test conditions: ambient temp, chassis limits, and power capping. partner HW was tested at 25C in their lab last time.

maria: Good call. Proposal draft:
- Test rig: 4xA100-class board in standard airflow bench, ambient 24–26C
- Workload: 2k token prompts at 8 concurrent streams, steady state run 30m
- Metrics: throughput (seq/s), avg token latency, 95/99 lat, watts (wall), perf/W = seq/s per watt
- Pass criteria: perf/W within 5% of baseline (their reference) OR throughput within 10% while maintaining 95th < baseline+15ms

sam: Keep an eye on kernel variants — we saw a regression on the int8 path last quarter. Can we require kernel stability: no correctness regressions + <3% variance in perf across 3 runs?

maria: Yes. Add stability clause: 3 consecutive runs, variance <3% for throughput; bit-exactness check for fp16->int8 conversion not required but top-1 token distribution must not shift by >0.5% on sampled prompts.

alex: For observability, ask partners to provide perf logs + telegraf/prom exporter metrics and a small sample of raw KV cache traces (anonymized). We'll ingest into our console for the dashboard.

bench-bot: scheduled run created: job-id rwd-nv-joint-1765, starts 2026-06-12T09:00Z. Results will post to #partnerships-results and attach artifacts.

jin: For the public announcement: only include aggregate perf/W numbers and a short methods appendix. No raw telemetry. Also agree on a joint snippet about kernel tuning (we kept tuning mostly to memory layout changes).

maria: Draft of acceptance gate email to partners in thread: "We propose the above test rig and pass criteria. If you agree, we'll run the verification jobs next week; passing artifacts + our dashboard snapshot constitute acceptance. If variance is observed, we'll iterate on kernel build flags and re-run once." Thoughts?

sam: LGTM. One ask: include a quick mitigations list if we hit thermal headroom issues (fan tuning, power capping policy, slight frequency bump on memory).

alex: I'll add mitigations + a minimal script snippet to export power and throughput together:```bash
# sample capture loop
while true; do
  power=$(ipmitool sensor reading | grep "PWR" | awk '{print $2}')
  throughput=$(curl -s http://localhost:9000/metrics | grep "rwd_throughput" | awk '{print $2}')
  echo "$(date -u),$power,$throughput" >> joint-run.csv
  sleep 5
done
```

maria: Perfect. I'll send the email to NVIDIA eng and CC product/marketing for announcement sync. Thanks all — will post job link once bench-bot confirms. :rocket:

bench-bot: job rwd-nv-joint-1765 updated: artifact bucket created at s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/rwd-nv-joint-1765/

alex: tagging follow-ups: @sam will own kernel debug loop, @jin will draft methods appendix, @maria will own partner comms + announcement alignment.

maria: assigning and closing this thread for now — will reopen with results. :white_check_mark:
